hero.title: Charge on Solar — home exterior
hero.alt: Solar panels and a Powerwall on a stone-clad home, with an electric car charging outside.
hero.transform: Proportional resize to 1440px, WebP quality 82, method 6. No generated or substituted scene elements.
hero.caption: Home energy image from Tesla's UK Powerwall page.
hero.provenance: Downloaded from Tesla's official digital asset CDN; exact URL appears in the live UK Powerwall page HTML in the Charge on Solar section.
hero.reuse: Manufacturer copyright retained. No general third-party reuse licence was established; this manifest records provenance, not a rights clearance. Attribute Tesla when used in editorial product comparison.

videos.title: Store Extra Energy with Powerwall
videos.context: Tesla's UK Powerwall page explains storing surplus solar and charging from the grid in the Store Extra Energy section. This short, silent animation is used directly on that page; it is a Powerwall family explainer, not a filmed Powerwall 3 installation.
videos.verification: Source URL and matching poster found in the official page's video element; HTTP HEAD 200; ffprobe successfully decoded the remote MP4 metadata.

videos.title: Dura5 Home Energy Battery | Duracell Energy
videos.context: The current Duracell Energy homepage embeds this exact video. It is about Dura5; do not label it as a Dura16 video. YouTube oEmbed confirms the author as Duracell Energy and the official channel linked in the manufacturer's own footer.
videos.head_size_note: YouTube embed HTML returned Content-Length 0; this is not the video size. Actual streamed video byte size is not exposed by the embed endpoint.
videos.verification: Exact iframe with matching title is present in official homepage HTML. YouTube oEmbed author is Duracell Energy, matching the manufacturer's official footer channel.

videos.title: Hi-MO X6 — Born for Light
videos.context: English promotional film embedded in the Born for light section of LONGi's Hi-MO X6 product-family page.
videos.poster_note: Clean product still extracted at 95s from the official Hi-MO X6 film: black module against a silver textured background, without embedded text or efficiency claims.
videos.verification: Exact video src found in official Hi-MO X6 HTML; HTTP HEAD 200; ffprobe successfully decoded remote MP4 metadata.

official_caption_track.evidence: No HTML track elements or VTT/SRT URLs in the official source-page HTML; remote ffprobe found video and audio streams only. No official caption file surfaced in manufacturer-domain searches. This is a bounded absence finding, not proof no unpublished caption file exists.

videos.title: Mission Zero — Residential Solar in South Africa
videos.kind: Official residential installation case study film
videos.context: AIKO's homepage case study identifies the Cotswold Downs residential project in South Africa; its published poster uses the spelling Costwold Downs. Video covers a real residential project in Hillcrest, KZN, South Africa.
videos.head_type_note: HEAD did not provide a Content-Type header; ffprobe recognized a valid MP4 with video and audio streams.
videos.verification: Exact video source and paired data-poster found in official AIKO homepage HTML; HTTP HEAD 200; ffprobe successfully decoded remote MP4 metadata.

official_caption_track.evidence: No HTML track elements or VTT/SRT URLs in the official source-page HTML; remote ffprobe found video and audio streams only. No official caption file surfaced in manufacturer-domain searches. This is a bounded absence finding, not proof no unpublished caption file exists.

integration_notes: Use local optimized WebP posters and preload=none for the large LONGi and AIKO films; create the player on user activation.
The Tesla and Duracell videos are manufacturer-produced explanatory animations. The AIKO film is a residential case study. Do not describe animations as filmed installations.
The Dura5 film is official; Dura16 YouTube results from Solar Xpress and Glow Green were excluded because they were installer channels.
Manufacturer copyright is retained on all source media. No broad third-party reuse licence was established; this is a provenance manifest rather than a rights clearance.
Only final WebP files and this manifest are intended for integration. Other files in this directory are intermediate source downloads and research HTML.
